title: Emsteel cement division’s revenues rise in third quarter of 2026 financial year
summary: Emsteel cement division’s revenues rise in third quarter of 2026 financial year
body_markdown:
**UAE:** Emsteel’s cement division generated revenues of US$68.6m in the third quarter of 2026, up by 12% year-on-year, according to the company’s latest results. Divisional earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) rose by 44% year-on-year to US$20.4m.


Cement and clinker sales volumes increased by 12% year-on-year to 921,000t. Emsteel said that this reflected continued strong demand for cement products. “Emsteel delivered strong results during the third quarter of 2026, despite a challenging market environment marked by geopolitical uncertainty, supply chain disruptions and cost pressures,” said Group CEO Saeed Ghumran Al Remeithi.
